aesthetics.notes: Colours/tiles pair nicely, I like the drain + sharp edges of the basin

splash.notes: Pretty poor mostly due to shallow basin

practicality.notes: Surface area too small to wash face, and tap in line of sight + built in so difficult to access plumbing

ratio.notes: Proportional and good for discouraging clutter

total.notes: Pretty but would not use for anything more than washing hands (at best)

aesthetics.notes: Nice tiles, cool shape, pretty splashback. But the paper-towel box stands out too much.

practicality.notes: Not good for washing away soap drips. But the foot pedal is *amazing*

ratio.notes: Enough space for soap and not much else. Good for discouraging clutter.

total.notes: Big points for the foot pedal.
